assertion: Homicides fell 15.2% across 66 major U.S. law enforcement jurisdictions during the first nine months of 2026, according to a report released Nov. 9 by the Major Cities Chiefs Association. The association's latest report recorded 3,394 homicides between Jan. 1 and Sept. 30, compared with 4,000 during the same period in 2025.

assertion: Robberies declined 9.1%, falling from 62,939 to 57,209 incidents, while reported rapes decreased 3.5%, from 21,231 to 20,483. Aggravated assaults dropped 3.4%, from 196,212 to 189,474.

Combined, the four categories accounted for 270,560 reported offenses during the first nine months of 2026, compared with 284,382 during the corresponding period last year. That represents 13,822 fewer violent crimes, an overall reduction of approximately 4.9%.

assertion: Memphis recorded 99 homicides through September, down from 156 during the same period in 2025, a decrease of approximately 36.5%. New York City reported 239 homicides, up from 192 during the same period last year, an increase of approximately 24.5%.
